<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Record page 3 column layout">426a984e79c0df54c34eb56e1a47c582</macroponent><name>On Merge Duplicates Page Load</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "There was a problem merging articles with AI (timed out). You can write it yourself now if you'd like."
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
async function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    // Only setup timeout if merge duplicates is being triggered via URL params
    if (api.context.props.sysId != '-1' || !api.state.isGeneratingMergeDuplicates || !api.context.props.duplicateSysIds) {
        return;
    }
        
    var timeoutMessage = await helpers.translate("There was a problem merging articles with AI (timed out). You can write it yourself now if you'd like.");
    
    var mergeDuplicatesTimeoutId = helpers.timing.setTimeout(function() {
        api.setState('isMergeDuplicatesTimedOut', true);
        api.setState('isGeneratingMergeDuplicates', false);
        api.emit("NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS", {
            items: [{
                id: "na_error",
                status: "critical",
                icon: "sn-sparkmoji-logo-outline",
                content: timeoutMessage,
                action: {
                    type: "dismiss"
                }
            }]
        });
    }, 180000);
    
    api.setState('mergeDuplicatesTimeoutId', mergeDuplicatesTimeoutId);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>felipe.valenca</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-21 16:26:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>566ad84e79c0df54c34eb56e1a47c501</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>On Merge Duplicates Page Load</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Escola Virtual" source="x_fub_fundbrad_ev">e56ecca5ecff031463f173bdfd6dd941</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Escola Virtual">e56ecca5ecff031463f173bdfd6dd941</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_566ad84e79c0df54c34eb56e1a47c501</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>felipe.valenca</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-21 16:26:42</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
